title: SpeicherSaver
description: Storage Saver A high-performance Minecraft server plugin that automatically deletes unused world files to reclaim 80%+ disk space while safely protecting player bases and builds.
body:
# StorageSaver

StorageSaver is a lightweight, high-performance Minecraft server plugin designed to automatically clean up unused region files (`.mca`) to reclaim valuable disk space. 

When players explore your world (e.g., flying with Elytras), the server generates huge amounts of terrain data. Usually, these chunks are only visited once and never again, unnecessarily bloating your world folder. StorageSaver resolves this issue by purging temporary exploration chunks while permanently protecting player bases, builds, and containers.

### Key Features
* **Save 80%+ Disk Space:** Safely removes bloated exploration chunks that players only visited once.
* **Folia & Paper Asynchronous Engine:** Built using modern asynchronous scheduling. Heavy scanning and deletion tasks run completely in the background without affecting server performance or causing TPS drops.
* **Intelligent Base Protection:** Instantly marks regions as protected if a player:
  * Places or breaks blocks
  * Interacts with containers (Chests, Shulker Boxes, Furnaces, etc.)
  * Interacts with Redstone components (Buttons, Levers, Plates, etc.)
  * Stays in the area for a configurable amount of cumulative time (e.g., 10 minutes)
* **Per-World Setup:** Keeps separate data tracking and whitelists for each individual world.
* **Safety First:** Currently loaded chunks or recently modified files are skipped automatically to prevent data corruption.
